verdict.rationale: Bland offers a full REST API, CLI, and batch calls (CSV upload for high-volume campaigns) which support headless/CI-style automation, and pathways/evals can be managed programmatically. However there is no explicit CI/CD integration guide, no documented exit-code/scripting examples for pipelines, and no mention of running in containerized/CI environments specifically. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples, headless authentication/setup guidance for automated environments, independent confirmation of CLI/API use in CI.
